changelog:
v0.3.0
- Check existing movies, seasons, and episodes directly in the Jellyfin library, including another check at approval time
- Restore feed and search posters through MediaForge's supported image proxy
- Adopt MediaForge's public endpoint-scope and API-key APIs with 1.5 compatibility
- Remove client-controlled Adult access and unsafe live view-function mutation
- Reject disabled or malformed sources, active image formats, and invalid queue responses
- Prevent stale search/detail responses and expose structured connector errors
- Avoid duplicate episode lookups and expand Jellyfin library matching tests
- Bound request persistence, recover interrupted handoffs, and keep progress polling after transient errors
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
